thesis:
本期从最近七天选入四组此前未覆盖的资料，没有把旧稿改日期。核心问题是“控制实际在哪里生效”：网关可能自身泄密，语义策略可能因配置或流式路径未覆盖而失效，子任务回传可能破坏已完成工作，模型分歧也不一定应被投票消除。安全公告、产品文档、开放基准和会议录用论文提供不同层级的证据；本期没有可以直接量化收入、节省工时或生产事故下降的业务对照。

四组材料对应四个不同分母：有漏洞的部署、实际被评估的调用、受到回传影响的任务，以及值得人工复核的内容。不能把补丁覆盖率、策略允许率、最终完成率和审核分流F1相互替代。最小可用控制链应记录“谁提出动作、走哪条实际路径、用了哪个状态版本、谁最终批准”，同时把原始秘密排除在模型及日志之外。

证据也不是越多代理就越独立：安全公告的发现者署名、同一团队的论文和仓库、同后端的五种提示，都有价值，但不构成相互独立的生产效果验证。本期最稳健的工程建议是先做带失败注入的影子试点，保留人工基线和严重错误分母，再决定是否扩大自主执行。
takeaways: LiteLLM公告把风险定位到启用企业许可证的特定代码路径，说明平台治理必须检查实际功能和发布线；严重度10.0不是被利用比例，两家发现署名也不等于公开复现或生产损失证据。
Google文档表明“已有策略”不等于“已经执行”：意图匹配、演练模式、接口路径与流式调用是独立覆盖条件。验收要从实际动作和评估日志对账，不能只读控制台配置；目前仍缺攻击召回和误拒数据。
Async-RBench的两组都并行，只比较回传协议。异步平均成功率低3.7个百分点提示结果整合值得单独测试，但受控时机、独立运行差异与单目标事件限制了因果和生产外推。
RTDA显示理由结构可以帮助寻找有争议案例，却不是正确处置标签。没有专业审核员在线研究前，应把它当影子队列排序信号，分别验证复核收益、遗漏和五次生成的成本，而非新的自动处罚门。
contrarian: 本期容易被接受的主张是“增加一个网关或监督代理，系统就会更安全可靠”。来源事实提供反例与限制：网关本身可能暴露秘密，语义政策存在未覆盖接口，强制重建计划只带来有限增益，多代理审核也只能预测争议。编辑判断是，在小规模、高风险工作流中，先缩小执行面、核对状态和建立可恢复队列，可能比增加自主组件更划算。这一判断只在人工容量尚可、任务可等待且动作可隔离时成立；若真实业务随机对照证明新增控制组件在相同权限和复核预算下，持续降低严重错误、总成本和处理时间，同时没有增加漏报或旁路，它就应被推翻。

items.title: LiteLLM企业代理披露未认证文件读取，网关本身成为密钥暴露面
items.type: 维护者安全公告＋开源仓库修复信息＋第三方发现者署名
items.summary: LiteLLM维护者披露，启用企业许可证的模型代理可能被未认证请求诱导读取本地文件，再把内容发送到外部地址。进程环境若保存代理主密钥及模型供应商密钥，泄露后可扩大到代理管理权限；部分配置还可能进一步执行高权限代码。未启用许可证的开源部署不受这条代码路径影响。对集中管理多家模型的企业，这不是回答内容安全问题，而是共享网关的基础设施暴露面：入口认证、回调参数、出站网络和密钥驻留位置必须分别检查，不能以“所有模型都经过代理”代替风险验证。
items.design: 公告描述的危险链路从模型路由收到外部请求开始，经企业功能中的文件读取与回调相关处理，将本地内容发往请求方指定的目标；它不是检索文档中的恶意指令，也不依赖模型先同意攻击。维护者建议升级，并以入口过滤、限制出站目标及避免把主密钥放入环境变量作为补充控制。实际修复应由平台和安全负责人批准，在隔离测试环境使用合成秘密验证，不能扫描第三方实例。公告没有给出所有内部调用、租户隔离或失败补偿细节；生产恢复应先阻断可疑路径，再核查访问日志、轮换可能暴露的凭证，验证正常模型请求后逐步恢复，这一恢复顺序属于编辑建议。
items.evidence: 证据等级：维护者确认的安全公告，非独立生产事故统计。确认事实是公告将严重度列为关键、评分为10.0，并列出四条发布线的补丁：1.103.10、1.104.8、1.105.6、1.106.5；应按所用发布线核对，不能把所有较低版本一概视为未修复。公告署名两家机构分别发现，但这不等于本期获得公开、独立复现实验。维护者主张出站白名单可阻止所述外传路径；其有效性仍取决于完整代理链和实际配置。未披露受影响实例数量、真实被利用记录、外泄规模、修复耗时或升级后错误率。编辑判断是集中网关可能放大密钥失陷范围，但单个公告不能证明所有代理都不安全，也不能用严重度评分推算事故概率。
items.idea: 为企业模型平台做一周网关暴露盘点：仅覆盖许可证状态、发布线、入口认证、出站允许列表和密钥保存方式，不编写攻击利用器。安全人员批准测试并人工复核异常；以受影响资产修复覆盖率、未认证可达路径、合成秘密外传拦截、凭证轮换分钟数和正常请求成功率验收。

items.title: Google新增意图匹配开关，但多模型语义治理不覆盖流式响应
items.type: 产品更新日志＋配置文档＋运行时治理架构
items.source: 2026年10月26日更新｜Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform

relatedLinks.label: 意图匹配、演练与日志配置

items.summary: Google允许管理员关闭语义治理中的用户意图匹配，并扩展了非自家模型的工具调用格式支持。意图匹配默认开启，除检查管理员约束，还判断动作是否符合用户请求；关闭后，一些不违反既有约束、却由邮件或网页诱导的动作将失去这层检查。此次更新的工程价值不在开关数量，而在可观测性：日志能够区分评估模式，团队可以验证某个请求实际使用了哪种保护。不过平台明确不支持流式模型响应，接入多个供应商也需要逐条匹配请求路径，不能据此声称全部工具调用已经统一受控。
items.design: 代理请求携带身份，网关拦截模型建议的工具动作，取回对应自然语言约束，并把动作、工具清单及聊天历史送给策略引擎；引擎返回允许或拒绝，拒绝时替换原有工具调用。管理员可独立设置演练模式，此时所有调用仍放行，只记录判定。配置更新可能数分钟后生效，必须从实际评估日志核对模式；更新整个元数据映射还可能覆盖其他开关。身份认证与语义判定并非同一职责，文档也没有证明应用端或旁路调用均被覆盖。低置信度、引擎超时及部分业务写入的恢复语义未在这些资料中完整披露；生产试点应保留人工审批与可审计的拒绝队列，不把演练日志当作已阻断证据。
items.evidence: 证据等级：官方可检查配置文档，非独立有效性评测。确认更新包括默认开启的意图匹配开关、实际模式日志及更多模型接口；发布说明和架构文档一致注明不支持流式响应。厂商警告关闭意图匹配会削弱间接提示注入保护，但没有公布攻击样本量、召回率、正常动作误拒、额外延迟或每次评估成本。文档还提醒拒绝理由可能暴露约束细节，可改为固定消息；这说明可解释日志和对外披露需要分离。编辑推断是接口覆盖、保护模式和执行模式必须共同验收，而不是只检查策略是否存在。尚无独立客户对照证明这次扩展降低事故；未知的超时行为及下游绕过路径，不能补写成默认拒绝或端到端保障。
items.idea: 为一个退款草稿助手做治理配置回归：只支持非流式模型及两项只读工具，覆盖不同供应商路径、带查询参数路径、意图开关和演练模式。负责人审批后才允许强制拦截；用应拦未拦、正常误拒、无评估日志调用、配置传播时延、拒绝信息泄露和人工复核分钟数验收。

items.title: Async-RBench中异步回传平均成功率26.0%，并行并不等于正确整合
items.type: 新预印本＋公开任务仓库＋受控异步执行评测
items.source: 2026年10月23日提交｜电子科技大学团队；Async-RBench

relatedLinks.label: 任务、协议与评测器获取说明

items.summary: Async-RBench研究主代理一边工作、一边收到子代理结果时，能否只修改被新证据影响的部分，保留仍有效的产物，并避免重复副作用。它以状态控制器安排迟到、重复、冲突和失败等回传，再用事件响应契约单独检查过程与结果。九个代理配置的平均最终成功率，逐条异步回传为26.0%，等必需子任务完成后批量交付为29.7%。两种模式都并行运行子代理，差异在交付协议，不是并行对串行。对采购比价、数据分析或多仓库修复，这提示团队先测结果整合，不能只展示多窗口同时运行。
items.design: 基准把业务式任务分给子代理，主代理和子代理在同一配置中使用相同模型；控制器根据预设状态释放消息。仅评测端可见的契约规定必须改变、保留、禁止和重新验证的事项，过程与事件结果各占一半，再另计最终任务成功。每次最多同时运行三个子代理，主代理上限一百次响应，子代理各四十次，四十分钟到期即停止。每题只隔离一个目标事件，不是生产事务平台，也没有完整用户权限或人工批准链。编辑建议把结果标识、对象版本和受影响范围写入外部账本；重复或冲突回传先冻结相关动作并转人员，不能通过重跑全流程抹去已发生的副作用。
items.evidence: 证据等级：未同行评审的受控实验，附部分公开制品。两百任务覆盖八类场景，九种配置在每种模式各重复三次；事件响应分为19.2至45.1，全部低于满分一半。要求每次回传后重建计划，仅在三个配置提高2.6至3.5分，调用增加7.5%至10.2%。论文四百零五次抽审的自动判定与人工一致率为96.6%，发现的基础设施问题修复后重跑。局限是提前结束也记事件零分，交付时机由控制器安排，两个模式的子代理独立运行引入输出差异，不能单独归因为异步。仓库公开任务但不含隐藏测试、调度和评测器，完整评分须另行获取；本期未运行复现。没有真实业务延迟、净成本或事故对照，不能外推为禁止并行。
items.idea: 给采购比价助手建立二十条回传回归，只生成比较草稿，不发订单；人为注入重复报价、过期版本、缺失报告和子任务失败，采购员处理冲突。以重复副作用、旧结果采用率、未受影响产物保留、必需检查完成率、最终合格率及每份草稿的时间与成本验收。

items.title: RTDA用理由与结论的分歧辅助转人工，但不判断谁的价值观正确
items.type: CIKM会议录用论文＋离线审核语料实验＋人工升级信号
items.source: 2026年10月26日提交；论文注明获CIKM 2026录用｜华沙理工大学
items.summary: RTDA不是再找一个模型做最终裁判，而是把多个审核代理的书面理由相似度与保留或删除结论是否一致交叉分类。理由相近却结论分裂的内容，会被视作值得人工关注的候选；系统希望保留争议结构，而不是用多数票把它消掉。在一千条英文仇恨言论语料上，该信号识别人类标注者高分歧内容的效果优于只看投票或口头置信度。值得企业社区与申诉团队关注的是转人工队列的设计，但理由只是模型生成文本，不能等同真实内部推理，更不能据此诊断不可调和的价值冲突或自动处罚用户。
items.design: 同一基础模型扮演五种不同审核视角，分别输出处置标签、书面理由和置信度；嵌入模型计算理由之间的相似度，再与结论一致程度组成四种状态。四票一致阈值事先确定，相似度阈值用独立校准集选择后冻结，测试时不再调参。每条内容需五次生成、五次嵌入和十次两两比较，不能把增量后处理很轻说成整套免费。它只评估分流信号，没有连接真实删帖权限、申诉系统或专业审核员。编辑建议模型仅读脱敏内容及当前规则，超时、缺失理由或结构解析失败均转普通人工队列；审核员决定最终处置并保留申诉，不能让模型投票自动授权封禁。
items.evidence: 证据等级：标注获会议录用的论文，单语料离线证据。训练与校准各两百条，另有一千条测试；高分歧定义为人类评分分歧最高四分之一，并非违规真值。结构信号的分流指标为AUROC 0.72、F1 0.59，投票熵为0.66、0.50，监督分类器为0.73、0.56；五种视角改为同样提示后，结构方法F1降为0.50。确认结果支持这种分歧结构具有预测关联，不证明伤害减少或人工工时节省。局限包括同一后端、公开旧语料可能被预训练见过、理由事后合理化、未测重复运行波动和跨语言泛化。作者给出的代码链接本次返回无法取得，独立复现未确认；尚无专业审核员在线对照，不能把标注者分歧直接解释为必须升级的业务风险。
items.idea: 为企业社区申诉团队做五十条脱敏历史内容的影子分流：比较单模型置信度、投票与理由结构，不直接删帖；两名审核员独立决定是否升级并记录原因。以值得复核案例召回、队列精确率、漏升级、每例审核分钟、模型费用和申诉改判率验收，再决定是否扩围。

projectIdeas.title: 模型网关覆盖核验器
projectIdeas.description: 目标用户是企业模型平台与安全团队；最小范围是一套测试网关、两家模型接口和两项只读工具，核对补丁、许可、非流式路径、意图及演练模式。安全负责人批准测试与切换，异常不自动修配置。以漏管调用、合成秘密外传、误拒、配置生效时间、正常任务合格率及每千次治理成本验收。

projectIdeas.title: 回传与升级证据队列
projectIdeas.description: 目标用户是采购运营团队；最小范围为二十个比价任务的只读草稿，外部账本登记结果标识、版本、缺失证据与冲突理由，重复回传不得生成新业务动作。采购员处理冲突和最终批准，模型分歧只排序不裁决。以重复副作用、旧结果采用、漏升级、审核分钟、端到端合格率和每份合格草稿成本验收。

en.thesis:
This issue selects four previously uncovered sources from the past seven days, rather than relabeling an old briefing. The central question is where controls actually take effect: a gateway can itself leak secrets; semantic policies can miss actions because of configuration or streaming paths; subagent returns can damage completed work; and model disagreement should not always be voted away. Security advisories, product documentation, an open benchmark and an accepted conference paper offer different levels of evidence. None supplies a business comparison that directly quantifies revenue, hours saved or reduced production incidents.

Cross-source assessment: The four sources have different denominators: vulnerable deployments, calls actually evaluated, tasks affected by incoming results, and content worth human review. Patch coverage, policy allow rates, final completion and routing F1 cannot substitute for one another. A minimal control chain should record who proposed an action, its actual execution path, the state version used and the final approver, while keeping raw secrets out of models and logs.

More agents do not necessarily mean more independent evidence. Named vulnerability discoverers, a team's paper and repository, and five prompts on the same backend are useful, but are not independent validations of production impact. The strongest transferable recommendation is a failure-injected shadow pilot with a human baseline and a denominator for serious errors before expanding autonomous execution.
takeaways: The LiteLLM advisory locates the vulnerability in a particular Enterprise-license code path. Governance must inspect enabled features and release branches: a severity score of 10.0 is not an exploitation rate, and two credited discoverers do not establish public reproduction or production losses.

Google's documentation distinguishes having a policy from enforcing it: intent matching, dry-run mode, API paths and streaming are separate coverage conditions. Acceptance should reconcile actual actions with evaluation logs rather than inspect the console alone; attack recall and false-denial measurements remain absent.

Both Async-RBench groups run subagents concurrently; only the delivery protocol differs. A 3.7-percentage-point lower mean success rate with asynchronous delivery warrants separate integration tests, but controlled timing, independent-run variation and single target events limit causal and production extrapolation.

RTDA's rationale structure can help identify disputed cases, not correct moderation labels. Until professional-moderator online studies exist, treat it as a shadow-queue ranking signal and separately measure review benefits, omissions and the cost of five generations, not as a new automatic punishment gate.
en.contrarian: The tempting claim is that adding a gateway or supervisory agent makes a system safer and more reliable. The sources provide counterexamples and limits: gateways can expose secrets, semantic policies have uncovered interfaces, mandatory replanning produces limited gains, and multi-agent moderation predicts disagreement rather than correct decisions. Our editorial judgment is that narrowing execution scope, checking state and building recoverable queues may be more economical than adding autonomous components in small, high-risk workflows. This applies only when human capacity is available, work can wait and actions can be isolated. A real-business randomized comparison showing that an added control component persistently reduces serious errors, total cost and processing time under the same permission and review budgets, without increasing misses or bypasses, would overturn it.

items.type: Maintainer security advisory + open-source repository patch information + named third-party discoverers
items.source: October 27, 2026 | BerriAI / LiteLLM; Karmasec and Compass Security credited as discoverers
items.title: LiteLLM Enterprise proxy discloses unauthenticated file reads: the gateway itself can expose keys
items.summary: LiteLLM maintainers disclosed that a model proxy with an active Enterprise license can be induced by an unauthenticated request to read a local file and send it to an external address. If the process environment contains the proxy master key and provider API keys, exposure can escalate to proxy administration; some configurations may also permit privileged code execution. Open-source deployments without a license do not load the affected code path. For enterprises centralizing multiple models, this concerns infrastructure rather than answer-content safety. Ingress authentication, callback parameters, outbound networking and secret residence need separate checks; routing every model through a proxy is not risk validation.
items.design: The advisory describes an external request reaching an LLM route, passing through Enterprise file-reading and callback-related processing, and sending local contents to a requester-chosen destination. This is not malicious instructions in a retrieved document and does not require model agreement. Maintainers recommend updating, with ingress filtering, egress restrictions and keeping the master key out of environment variables as additional controls. Platform and security owners should approve remediation and validate it with synthetic secrets in an isolated environment, not scan third-party instances. The advisory does not disclose every internal call, tenant boundary or compensation mechanism. Our proposed recovery order is to block suspicious paths, inspect access logs, rotate potentially exposed credentials and gradually restore normal requests after validation.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: maintainer-confirmed security advisory, not independent production-incident statistics. The advisory rates severity Critical at 10.0 and lists patched branches at 1.103.10, 1.104.8, 1.105.6 and 1.106.5; match the deployed release branch rather than treating every lower-numbered version as unpatched. Two organizations receive independent-discovery credit, but this issue did not obtain a public independent reproduction. Maintainers say egress allowlisting blocks the described exfiltration; effectiveness still depends on the complete proxy chain and actual configuration. Affected-instance counts, confirmed real-world exploitation, leaked-data volume, remediation time and post-upgrade error rates are undisclosed. Centralization may amplify a key compromise, but one advisory neither establishes that all proxies are unsafe nor converts severity into incident probability.
items.idea: Run a one-week gateway exposure inventory for an enterprise model platform, limited to license status, release branch, ingress authentication, outbound allowlists and secret storage. Do not build an exploit. Security staff approve tests and review anomalies. Measure affected-asset patch coverage, unauthenticated reachable paths, synthetic-secret exfiltration blocks, credential-rotation minutes and normal-request success.

items.type: Product release notes + configuration documentation + runtime-governance architecture
items.source: Updated October 26, 2026 | Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
items.title: Google adds an intent-matching switch, but multi-provider semantic governance excludes streaming responses
items.summary: Google now lets administrators disable user-intent matching in semantic governance and supports tool-call formats from more non-Google models. Intent matching is enabled by default: besides checking administrator constraints, it tests whether an action fits the user's request. Disabling it removes that check from actions induced by emails or web pages that otherwise violate no stated constraint. The useful engineering change is observability, not the number of switches: logs distinguish evaluation modes so teams can verify the protection actually used for a request. However, streaming model responses are explicitly unsupported and each provider's request paths must be matched. Broader provider support is not proof that every tool call is governed.
items.design: Requests carry agent identity. The gateway intercepts model-proposed tool actions, retrieves natural-language constraints and sends actions, tool manifests and chat history to the policy engine. It returns allow or deny and replaces denied tool calls. Administrators can independently enable dry run, which still permits all calls and only logs verdicts. Configuration changes can take several minutes to propagate; inspect actual evaluation logs. Replacing the whole metadata map can also overwrite other switches. Authentication and semantic judgment serve different purposes, and these documents do not establish coverage of application-side or bypass calls. Low-confidence handling, engine timeouts and recovery from partial business writes are not fully specified. Pilots should retain human approval and an auditable denial queue; dry-run logs are not evidence of blocking.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: inspectable official configuration documentation, not an independent effectiveness evaluation. Confirmed changes include the default-on intent-matching switch, logs of the actual mode and additional provider interfaces. Release notes and architecture documentation both exclude streamed responses. Google warns that disabling intent matching weakens indirect-prompt-injection protection, but supplies no attack sample count, recall, normal-action false-denial rate, added latency or per-evaluation cost. Documentation also warns that denial rationales can reveal constraint details and offers fixed messages, separating explainable internal logs from public disclosure. Our inference is that interface coverage, protection mode and enforcement mode must be tested together, not merely policy existence. No independent customer comparison establishes fewer incidents; unspecified timeout behavior and downstream bypasses must not be described as fail-closed or end-to-end guarantees.
items.idea: Build a governance configuration regression for a refund-drafting assistant, limited to non-streaming models and two read-only tools. Cover provider paths, query-string paths, intent matching and dry run. An owner approves any switch to enforcement. Measure missed blocks, false denials, calls without evaluation logs, propagation latency, information disclosure in denials and human-review minutes.

items.type: New preprint + public task repository + controlled asynchronous-execution evaluation
items.source: Submitted October 23, 2026 | University of Electronic Science and Technology of China team; Async-RBench
items.title: Async-RBench reports 26.0% mean success with asynchronous returns: parallel work is not correct integration
items.summary: Async-RBench tests whether a main agent receiving results while it works updates only what new evidence invalidates, preserves valid artifacts and avoids duplicate side effects. A state controller schedules delayed, duplicate, conflicting and failed returns; event-response contracts assess process and outcomes separately. Across nine configurations, mean final success is 26.0% for individual asynchronous returns versus 29.7% when results are delivered together after required subworkflows finish. Both modes run subagents concurrently: this compares delivery protocols, not parallel and serial execution. Procurement comparisons, analysis and multi-repository fixes should therefore test integration rather than merely demonstrate simultaneous agent windows.
items.design: Tasks are delegated to subagents, with the same underlying model used by main and subagents within each configuration. A controller releases messages at predefined states. Evaluator-only contracts specify required changes, preservation, prohibitions and re-verification; process and event outcome have equal weight, alongside a separate final-success score. Up to three subagents run concurrently, with 100 main-agent responses, 40 per subagent and a 40-minute timeout. Each task isolates one target event. This is not a production transaction system and lacks a full user-permission or human-approval chain. Our proposal is an external ledger of result IDs, object versions and affected scope. Duplicate or conflicting returns should freeze relevant actions for human review, rather than rerun everything and obscure side effects already incurred.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: controlled, non-peer-reviewed experiment with partially public artifacts. Two hundred tasks cover eight scenarios; nine configurations run three repetitions per mode. Event-response scores range from 19.2 to 45.1, all below half the maximum. Mandatory replanning improves three configurations by only 2.6–3.5 points while increasing calls by 7.5–10.2%. An audit of 405 runs reports 96.6% agreement between automated decisions and human judgments; identified infrastructure problems were fixed and affected runs repeated. Early termination receives zero event credit, timing is controller-driven and independently executed subagents vary between modes, preventing attribution solely to asynchronous delivery. The repository exposes tasks but excludes hidden tests, schedules and the judge, which must be obtained separately; we did not reproduce the experiment. There is no real-business latency, net-cost or incident comparison, and no basis for banning parallelism.
items.idea: Create 20 return-handling regressions for a procurement comparison assistant that produces drafts but never orders. Inject duplicate quotes, stale versions, missing reports and subtask failures; a buyer handles conflicts. Measure duplicate side effects, stale-result use, preservation of unaffected artifacts, completion of required checks, final acceptance and draft time and cost.

items.type: CIKM-accepted paper + offline moderation-corpus experiment + human-escalation signal
items.source: Submitted October 26, 2026; paper states acceptance at CIKM 2026 | Warsaw University of Technology
items.title: RTDA uses rationale and decision disagreement for escalation, not to decide whose values are correct
items.summary: RTDA does not appoint another model as final judge. It crosses similarity among moderators' written justifications with agreement on keep/remove decisions. Similar reasons with divided conclusions identify candidates for human attention, preserving disagreement rather than voting it away. On 1,000 English hate-speech-corpus items, the signal identifies high human-annotator disagreement better than voting or verbalized confidence alone. Enterprise communities and appeals teams may find the queue-design approach useful, but generated rationales are not direct access to internal reasoning. They cannot diagnose irreducible value conflict or justify automatic punishment.
items.design: One base model plays five moderation perspectives, each producing a disposition, written rationale and confidence. An embedding model measures rationale similarity, which combines with decision agreement into four states. A four-of-five agreement threshold is preset; a separate calibration set selects the similarity threshold, frozen before testing. Each item requires five generations, five embeddings and ten pairwise comparisons. Lightweight incremental post-processing does not make the whole panel free. The study evaluates routing signals without real deletion rights, appeals integration or professional reviewers. Our proposal grants read-only access to de-identified content and current rules. Timeouts, missing rationales or parse failures go to the ordinary human queue; reviewers decide dispositions and preserve appeals, with no voting-based authorization to ban users.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: paper reporting conference acceptance, with offline evidence from one corpus. Training and calibration each use 200 items, with another 1,000 for testing. High disagreement means the top quartile of human-rating disagreement, not true policy violation. Structural routing scores AUROC 0.72 and F1 0.59, versus 0.66 and 0.50 for vote entropy and 0.73 and 0.56 for a supervised classifier. Replacing five perspectives with identical prompts reduces structural F1 to 0.50. These findings support predictive association, not reduced harm or reviewer hours. Limitations include shared backends, potential pretraining exposure to the old public corpus, post-hoc rationalization, unmeasured repeated-run variability and cross-language generalization. The supplied code link could not be retrieved in this run; independent reproduction is unconfirmed. There is no professional-moderator online comparison, and annotator disagreement is not automatically business escalation risk.
items.idea: Shadow-route 50 de-identified historical items for an enterprise-community appeals team. Compare single-model confidence, voting and rationale structure without deleting content. Two reviewers independently decide whether escalation is warranted and record reasons. Measure recall of review-worthy cases, queue precision, missed escalations, review minutes, model costs and appeal reversal rates before expansion.
